avis.titre: Gentle yet effective brightening peeling gel for more radiant smooth skin
avis.texte: This brightening peeling gel is gentle, yet effective. It does not irritate my skin at all (even though I do not consider myself to have sensitive skin) but I usually do avoid any type of "peeling gel/cream" or harsh exfoliants that can strip away my skin's natural moisture and damage my skin barrier. I am not sure if there are small particles in this cream, but I would squeeze the product into my palms, before applying them onto my face, then I start to blend the products into my face and work in circular motion, and within seconds, I can feel it working, I did not feel any skin sensation, but what I meant was, I can feel the gel actually "exfoliating" and the feel of dead skin come off. I work that very well all over my face, before rinsing off my face with cool water. My skin feels baby soft and smooth afterwards. This is why I am a fan of Korean skin care products, they work so well, and some work way better than some luxury european skin care brands that I have spend a fortune on, and this brightening and peeling gel is at a fraction of their price, yet work so much better than some of the more expensive ones. This peeling gel is gentle enough for me to use at least 3-4x a week! Let's see how much it will improve my skin texture after I finish the first bottle. I definitely plan to repurchase.

avis.titre: A gentle peel I actually feel comfortable using
avis.texte: As a mom, I’m very careful with skincare — my skin doesn’t always react well to strong products, and I simply don’t have time to deal with irritation. This peeling gel turned out to be a really pleasant surprise. It’s very gentle, no burning or redness, and the process feels more like a soft massage than a harsh exfoliation. After using it, my skin feels smooth and fresh, but not dry or tight. I can use it in the evening and still feel comfortable putting on my regular skincare right after. I also appreciate that it doesn’t have a strong smell and rinses off easily — small things, but they matter when you’re always in a rush. I use it about once or twice a week, and that’s more than enough. The bottle lasts a long time, and the result is exactly what I want: clean, soft skin without stress. For busy moms who want gentle care that actually works, this is a great option.

avis.titre: Scam product. The paste itself clumps, its not removing skin.
avis.texte: This product is a scam. Initially when using it, I was fooled like the other buyers. When rubbing it in it creates a bunch of white clumps that look like dead skin being exfoliated. But it's just the paste itself doing that. Put a drop on a plate and just smear it around with your finger and it does the same thing. This product ie a scam and any good results are just a placebo because of the fake "peeling" effect it has. In the picture below I put it on a plastic cup and smeared it around with a plastic spoon and it did the same clumping it does on skin. Guess the plastic cup had a lot of dead skin to exfoliate, huh.
